risks.risk: Whether the machine is fully working (stitching, speed control, needle movement) is not shown.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine running while sewing a straight line on fabric (with the needle moving) and showing the stitch/length settings changing.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed working (worst case) based on the cheapest comparable.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, needles, presser feet, manual) could reduce value.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing all included items laid out (power cord, foot pedal, bobbin case, bobbins, needles, presser feet, manual if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case) near the low end.

risks.risk: Model/feature level is unclear (basic home machine vs higher-spec), which affects value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/serial plate (usually on the side/back/bottom) and the control panel labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a basic home sewing machine (worst case) rather than a higher-spec unit.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in these angles (cracked casing, rusted internal parts, bent needle, worn gears).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, underside/bottom, and any visible wear points.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as average-worn used condition (worst case) until proven otherwise.

proof_requests: Video: machine running and sewing on fabric (straight stitch + one other stitch/setting).
Photos of included accessories: power cord, foot pedal, bobbins/bobbin case, needles, presser feet, and any manual.
Clear close-up of the model/serial plate (side/back/bottom) so the exact model can be identified.
Close-ups of needle area/feed dogs and underside/bottom for wear or damage.
